His comments highlight divisions within the Monetary Policy Committee over how to balance rising energy prices against risks to economic growth.

supporting_news.title: India bonds sink deeper on RBI commentary, inflation concerns
supporting_news.summary: Indian government bonds are currently facing notable losses, pushing the 10-year yield to its highest since March 2023. This downturn comes in the wake of hawkish remarks from Reserve Bank of India Governor Sanjay Malhotra about financial stability. Additionally, India's wholesale inflation saw an unexpected rise in September, leading to growing concerns over potential future monetary policy shifts.
